detail.en-US: Training targets were available before each test date; next-year target availability follows formation.
detail.zh-CN: 训练目标在测试日前可得，下一年度目标的可得日在形成日之后。

detail.en-US: Announcement alignment does not supply the complete historical financial revision chain.
detail.zh-CN: 公告对齐不能补出完整历史财报修订链。

detail.en-US: Common price-complete subsets can introduce survivorship selection.
detail.zh-CN: 共同价格完整子集可能引入幸存选择。

detail.en-US: Delisting-aware returns and terminal recovery remain incomplete.
detail.zh-CN: 退市感知收益与终止事件回收仍不完整。

detail.en-US: Adjusted-close endpoints are price proxies, not fills or total-return accounts.
detail.zh-CN: 复权收盘端点是价格代理，不是成交或总收益账户。

detail.en-US: Fixed entry/exit costs are modeled; impact is not modeled.
detail.zh-CN: 模拟固定买卖成本，但没有市场冲击模型。

data_version.en-US: Input vintage 20260802; outcome snapshot 20260831; 2023–2025 test folds.

missing.en-US: A source entry or artifact hash does not certify a complete rerun; original availability, dependencies and historical eligibility must match.
missing.zh-CN: 来源入口或产物哈希不等于完整复跑认证；原始可得性、依赖和历史资格必须一致。

resume_when.en-US: Add qualified historical revisions, industry and market-cap controls, longer cohorts and delisting-aware returns before promotion.
resume_when.zh-CN: 先补充可靠历史版本、行业与市值控制、更长样本和退市感知收益，再考虑升级。

action.en-US: Add qualified historical revisions, industry and market-cap controls, longer cohorts and delisting-aware returns before promotion.
action.zh-CN: 先补充可靠历史版本、行业与市值控制、更长样本和退市感知收益，再考虑升级。

acceptance.en-US: Retain an immutable audit with the named evidence gap resolved; preserve the previous decision if the gate fails.
acceptance.zh-CN: 保留不可变审计并解决上述证据缺口；门槛未通过则保留原判断。

action.en-US: Paired uncertainty, annual / size slices and calibration retained under the fixed retrospective follow-up.
action.zh-CN: 已按固定回溯方案保留配对不确定性、年度／规模切片与校准记录。

acceptance.en-US: Hashes and original cohort/metric reproduction checks passed; no executable return claim.
acceptance.zh-CN: 哈希与原始样本／指标复现检查通过，不声称可执行收益。

diagnostic_note.en-US: Retrospective paired diagnostics: monthly circular blocks of 12 for R&D; issuer resampling within one year for forecast errors. These intervals do not remove exploratory selection, incomplete financial revisions or market-time dependence. Positive forecast MAE differences mean worse errors.
diagnostic_note.zh-CN: 回溯配对诊断：研发按 12 个月循环区块，预测误差在同一年内重采样公司。区间不能消除探索选择、不完整财报版本或市场时间依赖；预测 MAE 差值为正表示误差更大。
